content: Yeesu ɓayuuɗ ŋ Pilaat ne a atte'u
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa teel, kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa cohha na jangɗohoh caŋ wa, na yakak ca, na saangnaŋ atte'oh ca jen. Ɓa tokɗukka Yeesu, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ Pilaat.
Wa ɓa ree, Pilaat meekissa ɗe ne : « A fu buuriŋ Yawuut ci e ? » Yeesu loffa ɗe ne : « Fu woyiɗa ! »
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa yambeeɗa ɗe in laayiɗ.
Pilaat woyissa ɗe ne : « Fu lofanɗi e ? Fu kerahɗi in ci laayiɗ ci ɓa na yambee ɗa e ? »
Waaye Yeesu lofisɗi ali in ; ineem feyya Pilaat.
Waam, feet Paak reyeen ɗah, Pilaat faɗsiɗ ɓa ambuuɗ yino ŋ ɓa nik ŋ kasoona, ɓeɗ na tanootee ɗe.
Wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Barabaas ; a ɓaahee ŋ ɓa hiñohee na nguura. Wa kurka yoond, ɓa apee ɓo', ɓa taƴuusa ŋ kasoona.
Mboolnda kaɗta ŋ Pilaat, ɓa woyeeɗa ɗe ne : « Haɓɗiɗa ɓoo ini fu na cure ɓoo tumiɗ kiis nu ree. »
Pilaat loffa ɓa ne : « Ɗu waaɗ ne ŋ faɗsiɗ ɗu buuriŋ Yawuut ci e ? »
A inheen ne waaɗa ɓooɓa waaɗ Yeesu, weɗ tah po kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa degga ɗe ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe.
Waaye ɓa yoppa mboolnda ne ɓa woyaat ne : Barabaas !
Pilaat woyissa ɓa ne : « Moo ɗu waaɗ ne ŋ tum ƴaari ɗu teek buuriŋ Yawuut ci na ? »
Ɓa leehkisseeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne : « Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa ! »
A meekissa ɓa ne : « A haɓiɗ ye in moɗaaɗi ? » Waaye ɓa uupeeɗa nga leehuk ŋ ɗafka an : « Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa ! »
Pilaat waaɗta jam, a taambiɗta mboolnda ŋ ini neɓ ɓa ; a faɗsiɗta ɓa Barabaas, a nakohha Yeesu laɓu na leraw po ƴutta, a eɗta soldaar ca ɗe ne ɓa daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Ɓa ɓayya ɗe leero kahan goornoor, ɓa ɓeeɗukka soldaar ca ɓinooɓa jen.
Ɓa ɓekiɗta ɗe kulɓa ruumind po haa buur, ɓa teɗta ñapir, ɓa ɓekiɗta ɗe wa ŋ haf findi mbahne-buur.
Ɓa kañɗeeɗa ɗe an : « Ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗa buuriŋ Yawuut ci. »
Ɓa laɓeeɗa ɗe ŋ haf na ngeer, ɓa tuhseeɗa ɗe, ɓa ƴekeeɗa ŋ fikiice.
Wa ɓa njembit ɗe po ƴutta, ɓa wolla kulɓaaka ɓa ɓekɗee ɗe, ɓa ɓekɗissa ɗe kulɓaacaŋ ɗe, ɓa ɓayeeɗa ɗe bilaf fa ne ɓa daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Yeesu daaƴuuɗ ŋ kurwaa
Waam raak ƴaar gen Sireen teeku Simong, baabiŋ Aleksaandar na Rufus, a pulohee ɓak caŋ yohon ca, a lahha ndaam, ɓa tufukka ɗe ne a deguk kurwaaniŋ Yeesu.
Ɓa ɓayya Yeesu po ŋ ɗiska na woyse Golgota, wa tokis "Ƴoh-haf",
ɓa waaɗta ɗe anɗukoh biiñ ambsohuuɗ na miir
, waaye a anɗi.
Ƴutta, soldaar ca daaƴca ɗe ŋ kurwaa, ɓa piilohha kulɓaacaŋ ɗe ne yaa nu nga ɗah inah ini a joy raak.
Wa raak yoor-yoora aaseeɗa.
Raakka ina ɓa fiis ndaam, ne wa teeɓoh ini tah ɗe daaƴu. Ɓa fiisee inii : « Buuriŋ Yawuut ci. »
Yeesu daaƴsee na rokoh kanak, yii lahha ɗe yaah-ñaahum, yum yaah-sing. [
Ɓooɓa taambee ŋ ɗiska njembteeɗa ɗe, ɓa kuɗteeɗa haf, ɓa ɓaseeɗa ɗe an : « Ngec ! Fu yi woyee ne, fu hey yahrohe Kahniŋ Kooh, fu taɓahisa ŋ neeh kaahay,
mucɗa haf fu, fu ruhus ŋ kurwaani ! »
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa ŋ harmban ɓa, na jangɗohoh caŋ wa nameeɗa ɗe njembit an : « A mucɗiɗ ɓinooɓi, a minɗi muciɗ haf ce !
Mucɗohi Gapohse, buuriŋ Israayel, ruhsaat ŋ kurwaani win-win, ɓoo hot, ɓoo han kos. » Ɓa daaƴsee na ɗe nameeɗa ɗe ɓas.
Kaanaŋ Yeesu
Wa njooloora ree, kehƴi jen nikka ŋ ñuus ini ree wahtu kaahay.
Wa wahtu ceem mit, Yeesu leehukka ŋ ɗafka, a woosa ne : « Eloyi ! Eloyi ! Lema sabahtani ? » weɗ ne "Koohiŋ ngo ! Koohiŋ ngo ! Wa ye tah fu faɗta so ?"
Ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ ɓa nikee ŋ ndaam kerahhaa, ɓa woosa ne : « Kerhaat, a na ɓeeɗke Ilyas

Ƴaar nga ɓa nuppa, ɓayya daah, a hooƴcaa ŋ masuɓ raakiɗ bineegar, a tokkaa ŋ lecem ndooɗ, a deggaa ŋ nguɓiŋ Yeesu ne a an. Ƴaara woosa ne : « Sekaat ɓoo marak, andi Ilyas hey ɗe hee ruhsiɗe ŋ kurwaani. »
Yeesu leehukka, nguɗta.
Ridoona ɗasɗee Ɗiska Hoolohngaanaŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh faarukka tareet ini kooɗoh ɗafka po kehƴa.
Ƴaara adgohee soldaar ca, ya tufkee ŋ fiki Yeesu, hotta findi a kaanoh, a woosa ne : « Wa keeh ne ƴaarii nikee Kuɓu Kooh. »
Raakeen ɓitiɓ ca tufkee usiɗ markeeɗa. Mari Makdala ɓaahee nga na Salome na Mari yi yaay ɓi Yoose na Saak yi ƴini.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ ñaakɗee Yeesu te ɓeɗ meeɗ ɗe taambkoh wa a nik ŋ Galile. Nameen raak ɓitiɓ wiiriis laayiɗ, ɓaah ŋ ɓa hunee na ɗe Yerusalem.
Ɗaakuukaŋ Yeesu
Ŋ noh niinɗaŋ mbehi na kooɗkohse, wi adug mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse
, Suseef ya genee Arimate hayya. A nikee ɓo' yeguuɗ ŋ atte'oh ca te a yi ŋ haf ce, a namee sek Nguuriŋ-Kooh. Hooɓa wa kee hooɓa tahha po a kaɗta ŋ Pilaat na fit, a meekissa ɗe fiɗaafa.
Pilaat feyuusa wi a kerah ne Yeesu ariɗ kaan, a nakohha ɓeeɗkiɗu ƴaara adgohee soldaar ca, a meekissa ɗe andi a ɓaatsiɗiɗ kaan.
Pilaat kerahha ini yeem lof, a teyɗukiɗta Suseef ne a ɓayaat fiɗaafa.
Suseef rommba uuf leeŋ, a ruhsiɗta faanaŋ Yeesu ŋ ɗiska wa daaƴsee ; a lemessaa na uufa, a ɓekkaa ŋ ruy-ruy huruuɗ ŋ atoh. Ƴutta, a pilnginnda atoh yakak, a ranngaa naa.
Raak Mari Makdala na Mari yaay ɓi Yoose nga, ɓa markeeɗa ŋ ɗiska Yeesu ɗaaku.
